response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The retrieved related functions cover surface assessment, cover displacement, residue transfer and ordinary root placement, but do not establish prepared-surface compatibility. root-planting-trial@1 rejected the examined footprint despite reported zero cover and residue. This does not prove either surface-21-lin-113 or residue-deposit-30-lin-175 caused the rejection. Hand off a narrowly scoped compatibility extension for development in this conversation, reusing existing placement and assessment code rather than reinventing them. Approval is not execution, clearance certification or personal mastery; development/review waiting advances no world time.\",\"specification\":\"Implement the smallest executable adapter for examining and placing on surface-21-lin-113 at (9.25,12.9), radius 0.2. Record code reuse of long.root-planting, revision root-planting-trial@1, and long.soil-worksite-assessment, revision soil-worksite-assessment@1, including their existing conservation, ageing and evidence logic. Do not duplicate the ordinary placement function. The adapter adds an exact preparedSurfaceId reference and a shared, corrected compatibility predicate used by both examination and placement. Modes: examine(preparedSurfaceId), plant(preparedSurfaceId,inputStackId), resume(processId), cancel(processId). Bind this version to the nominated surface and Lin; no arbitrary object exemption. Prerequisites: individual adapter study, and individual study of root-planting-trial, whose existing learning duration remains 2, before placement. If separately invoking soil-worksite-assessment, retain its existing duration 1. No study or resource is granted by this review. Adapter study takes one actual round and 0.2 energy.\\nBefore starting, validate exact visible references, bounds, available energy, physical access and live geometry. Use the root operation's ordinary-soil requirement and maximum reach of 0.65 plus actor body radius, while requiring an unobstructed actual hand-access path to the working footprint; do not grant travel. One completed non-destructive examination costs one round and 0.5 energy. It reserves and consumes no root and changes no site material. Invalid references or unreachable invocations do not start or charge. A performed examination that finds incompatibility still costs 0.5 energy and records that result. Interrupted examination before its atomic execution has no completed finding.\\nInspect live cover and residue and the actual occupied geometry of the entire placement footprint. A prepared-surface record is not itself an obstacle merely because it is an object: exempt only this verified non-solid, non-reserved surface annotation from the generic object-presence rejection, never its real cover, residues, occupants or unrelated locks. Check actual people, plants, solid obstacles, reservations, material overlap, terrain and reachable working geometry independently. Non-solid does not mean physically empty. Check residue-deposit-30-lin-175 by its live constituent positions and occupied extents rather than deleting it or assuming its center or annotation is decisive. Leave that deposit and every other root untouched. Zero reported cover/residue is necessary but not a soil-suitability certificate. Do not reveal hidden occupants or resources: report visible blockers, unsupported compatibility conditions, or that physical clearance could not be established without disclosing concealed identities. A software predicate limitation must be distinguished from an observed physical obstruction. Unknown required conditions block placement without site modification.\\nA plant invocation first performs this paid examination. Only after feasibility is established, revalidate ownership, accessibility and freshness of inputStackId=item-3-lin-12 and atomically reserve exactly one unspoiled root unit, 10 quantityTenths, together with a local work lock. The supplied quantity of three and decay value are historical facts, not guaranteed current stock or viability. Remaining stack quantities retain their real age and position. Use two additional work rounds at one energy each through the reused placement handler; total successful fresh invocation is three rounds and 2.5 energy, plus any actual travel. No tools, water or extra material are supplied. If current hand-only placement cannot execute the existing bounded soil work while conserving displaced material, stop with the specific unsupported requirement rather than inventing clearing or excavation.\\nPersist an exact process ID, surface reference, immutable footprint, input provenance, reserved tenths, paid completed work rounds, actual site changes and output reference. Revalidate clearance, reach, root condition and locks before each work step and final placement. A new blocker pauses before that step's charge or mutation; never consume a second root on resume. Resume requires the exact personal process ID, charges only outstanding work, and preserves prior paid work and real changes. A new examination outside that process is separately paid. Interruption preserves progress and escrow; cancel settles once, releases locks and returns only surviving unplanted root through the existing physically valid escrow-return mechanism, without teleportation or duplicated stock. Death releases surviving unplanted escrow on the ground. Spoiled material follows existing decay accounting and is not replaced or refunded. No energy, elapsed time, completed labor or material loss is refunded. Preserve any actual partial soil changes; do not silently restore the site. Repeated cancel/resume cannot settle twice.\\nFinal commitment atomically transfers the same reserved root into one persistent trial plot and releases the work lock. Record the generated plot ID, surface ID, input stack provenance, exact transferred quantity and completion event. Keep the surface's history linked to the plot; do not turn the annotation into a new material source. Input equals surviving escrow plus placed root plus explicitly accounted spoilage or physically returned material at every transition. Retain existing environmental ageing while paused and after placement. There is no unattended labor, propagation, guaranteed viability, growth, fertility, harvest, tending benefit or food output. The existing 30-round checkpoint remains inconclusive. No maintenance is required for a passive trial record; later observation or handling uses existing paid probe/root-assessment operations and their study requirements. Implement validation, charging, deduplication and settlement in code, with tests for annotation-only overlap, real obstacle overlap, residue overlap, changed clearance, spoilage, interruption and repeated cancellation; do not send ordinary executions back for model review.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Functionally this adds a compatibility check and bounded physical trial, not a reward source. Requests, queries, development approval, registration, study and naming grant no experience benefit. An actually performed examination may use the existing evidence-deduplicated grounded-understanding rule only for verified, personally applicable information gain, including an informative incompatibility; unchanged repeated findings and mere placement grant none. Reuse its existing amount, cap, decay and cooldown rather than introducing another reward channel; if those controls cannot be resolved in implementation, emit evidence only. Familiar legitimate hands-on practice may qualify only under an already coded modest, bounded practice rule, deduplicated against the same event. No automatic pleasure or maintained-satisfaction grant is added. No comfort benefit is established; physical comfort remains capped at 10. Nutrition, protected reward accounts, budget, goals and permissions remain unchanged.
